message: Hi, I'm a student with a shell programming certification background. My overall academic average is 73.7% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Computer Architecture and testing. I want to become a Technical Engineer. My family can afford at most about USD 6100 per year. I live in Bengaluru. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

constraints.career_goal: Technical Engineer (interested in Computer Architecture and testing)

reflection_note: The original list was reviewed. PR0015 was dropped because its business focus (BIS) is too far from the student's core technical goal of Computer Architecture/Technical Engineering. To maintain 5 entries, I swapped in PR0013 as a better alternative due to its blend of technical and design skills. Additionally, since PR0073 was kept on the shortlist but also appears in the full candidate set (and thus eligible for swap_in), I re-evaluated the remaining candidates. After dropping PR0015, PR0087 (MSc Data Science) is added to fill the fifth slot because it maintains a strong technical focus and meets all hard constraints (Bengaluru location, low tuition). The final ranking prioritizes direct CS fit (PR0173), followed by testing/SE relevance (PR0085), then other high-tech fields (PR0073, PR0013), and finally a strong technical backup option (PR0087).
explanation:
Longford Technical University
This program is recommended because its MTech Computer Science degree aligns well with your technical engineering goals and fits within your budget, requiring only $500 in annual tuition. Since the minimum required grade percentage is 53%, your academic background of 73.7% makes you a strong candidate. The main trade-off here is that while the program offers low cost and high accessibility, its placement rate (62%) and median starting salary ($6851) are moderate compared to other options.

Keystone Institute of Applied Sciences
This MSc in Software Quality Engineering directly addresses your interest in testing, making it a highly relevant choice for your career goal. The program is located in Bengaluru and has an annual tuition cost of $1450, which respects your budget constraint. However, the trade-off to consider is that while the curriculum matches your interests, its placement rate (63%) and median starting salary ($6488) are among the lowest on this list.

Elmhurst Technical University
This MTech Cyber Security program offers excellent employability, boasting an 80% placement rate and a high median starting salary of $8637. It is located in Bengaluru and requires a CS background, which matches your academic history. The main trade-off is that the minimum required grade percentage (65%) is slightly higher than your current standing, though you are still eligible.

Meridian Institute of Technology
This MSc Human-Computer Interaction program offers the highest median starting salary ($9186) and a strong placement rate of 77%, making it excellent for employability. The tuition cost is also very low at $900, keeping you well under your budget limit. The primary trade-off to consider is that while the salary potential is high, the program's focus on design (HCI) deviates from your core interest in Computer Architecture and testing.

Aravalli Technical University
This MSc Data Science option provides a technical degree relevant to modern engineering fields and is located in Bengaluru with an annual tuition of $1200. Since you have an IT/CS background, this program meets the requirement for CS knowledge. The main trade-off here is that despite its technical focus, it has the lowest placement rate (58%) and median starting salary ($6767) among the shortlisted options.
